# Lab 5.1: SQL UDFs

## What We Are Going to Do
Create a temporary SQL function for one query, then a persistent function that anyone with access to the dataset can reuse.

## Steps

1. **[CLI] Create the module dataset.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • BASH
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">bq --location=US mk --dataset $PROJECT_ID:lab05</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


2. **[SQL] A temporary UDF.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE TEMP FUNCTION margin_pct(price FLOAT64, cost FLOAT64)
RETURNS FLOAT64
AS (ROUND(SAFE_DIVIDE(price - cost, price) * 100, 1));

SELECT name, retail_price, cost, margin_pct(retail_price, cost) AS margin
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
ORDER BY margin DESC LIMIT 5;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


   The temp function exists only for this query.

3. **[SQL] A persistent UDF with a description.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lab05.price_band(price FLOAT64)
RETURNS STRING
OPTIONS (description = 'Budget / Mid / Premium price band')
AS (
  CASE WHEN price &lt; 25 THEN 'Budget'
       WHEN price &lt; 100 THEN 'Mid'
       ELSE 'Premium' END
);</span>
</code></pre>
</div>


4. **[SQL] Reuse it in another query.**


<div style="margin:18px 0;border:1px solid #334155;border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;">
<div style="background:#243244;color:#DBEAFE;padding:7px 12px;font-family:Segoe UI,Arial,sans-serif;font-size:12px;font-weight:700;">
CODE • SQL
</div>
<pre style="margin:0;background:#111827;color:#F3F4F6;padding:16px;overflow-x:auto;white-space:pre;font-family:Consolas,'Cascadia Code',monospace;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55;"><code><span style="color:#F3F4F6;">SELECT lab05.price_band(retail_price) AS band, COUNT(*) AS products
FROM `bigquery-public-data.thelook_ecommerce.products`
GROUP BY band;</span>
</code></pre>
</div>

6. **[Console] Find it in Explorer.** Expand `lab05 → Routines → price_band`. Open the **Details** tab to see the body and arguments.

## Expected Result

| Thing | Reality |
|---|---|
| Temp UDF | Works only in the query that defines it |
| Persistent UDF | Stored in `lab05`, reusable |
| Output | Products counted per price band |
| Explorer | Routine listed under `lab05` |
